title: Bulk RNA Extraction from Mouse Striatum
author: sriparna.mukherjee
materials: Wash the column using the kit-provided wash buffers (RW1 and RPE) in the sequence and volume specified by the supplier.

steps.title: Dissect striatum
steps.instruction: Dissect the striatum from the mouse brain using clean instruments.

steps.title: Collect tissue in RNase‑free tube
steps.instruction: Immediately place each dissected sample into a pre‑labeled RNase‑free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Optional snap‑freeze
steps.instruction: Either proceed directly to extraction or snap freeze the tissue and store at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Add Trizol to tissue
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of Trizol to the whole striatum (both hemispheres).

steps.title: Homogenize tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue thoroughly until the lysate is uniform and no visible fragments remain; incomplete homogenization can reduce yield and clog the column.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 70 % ethanol to the homogenized lysate and mix well by pipetting or gentle inversion until the solution is homogeneous.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a RNeasy spin column placed in a collection tube, loading 700 µL at a time.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge according to the kit's instructions to allow binding of RNA to the membrane.
If the total lysate volume exceeds the column capacity, reload the remaining lysate and repeat until all material has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Perform each wash step as directed by the manufacturer, centrifuging after each wash.

steps.title: Final dry spin
steps.instruction: Perform a final dry spin to remove residual wash buffer and ethanol; residual ethanol can interfere with downstream RNA quantification, quality assessment, enzymatic reactions, and library preparation.

steps.title: Transfer column to clean tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a clean RNase‑free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL RNase‑free water directly onto the membrane, incubate for 5 minutes, then centrifuge to elute RNA.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store purified RNA temporarily on ice for immediate quality measurements or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Assess RNA integrity
steps.instruction: Assess RNA quality and integrity using an Agilent BioAnalyzer or a comparable instrument.
